caption: The drawing depicts a monochromatic bust, likely rendered in sepia or brown tones, set against a light beige background. The bust represents a middle-aged to elderly man with shoulder-length, swept-back hair, prominent forehead, and deep-set eyes. He is dressed in a double-breasted coat or jacket with wide lapels and a high collar, complemented by a cravat or necktie around his neck, featuring detailed folds. The bust is sculpted to include the upper chest and shoulders, with the arms truncated, and rests on a rectangular base. The overall composition centers the bust vertically and horizontally on the plain background, and fine shading is used to create the three-dimensional effect and bring out details in the facial features, hair, and clothing.
title: Bust of Henry Clay
